test.summary: Box Module - Teams - Creating new team based on Jira Group

steps.action: Navigate to Teams module of a boxName
steps.data: boxName: TC-3261 Box Module - Teams - Creating new team based on Jira Group
steps.result:
Teams module is displayed

Wizard menu appeared with 3 tiles:

* Create new team (dropdown)
* Assign existing 
* Duplicate & edit existing

steps.action: Select Create new team dropdown menu
steps.result:
Three options appear on the list:

* regular
* based on Jira Group
* based on Jira Team

‘Create new team based on Jira group’ modal window is displayed with the following fields to create a team:

* Jira Cloud group
* Team code
* Color picker
* Board dropdown with "Select board" placeholder 
* Start date of Team memberships with today's date placeholder
* Create button
* Cancel button

steps.action: Select jiraGroup from dropdown menu, select startDate of Team memberships
steps.result:
Jira Group TC-3261 is selected

Team name is set automatically to TC-3261

Team code is TC3261

Start date of Team memberships is 01/Jun/22  with a "i" icon next to the name and tooltip 'Start date must be specified - this allows the app to include members in team planning and calculations'

Cancel button and Create button are displayed
Team TC-3261 based on Jira Group is created and it's visible on the list

steps.action: Click on teamName and select the Details tab.
steps.result:
Sidebar is expanded and displayed. Team name and code is displayed at the top of the sidebar. Violet lozenge JIRA CLOUD GROUP is displayed with a tooltip 'TC-3261 is based on and synchronized with Jira Cloud group'

Details tab is displayed.

Following fields are displayed: 

* Based on Jira Cloud group (red asterisk) with a placeholder TC-3261
* Name (red asterisk): TC-3261 
* Code and color: TC3261 and violet color
* Jira Board with "Select board" placeholder and information below: "Use the Board link to specify which Jira Scrum Boards are used by your Teams. This way, each time you add a new synchronized Box, the App can automatically create sprints on that Board."

Members tab is loaded and displayed. The following users are displayed on the list:

* TC-3261-01
* TC-3261-02
* TC-3261-03
* TC-3261-04

Their active membership starts from 01/Jun/22, availability is 100% and skills are empty

User selector is greyed out and non-clickable

steps.action: Hover over Remove button (trash icon) in teamMember row
steps.result: Remove button is greyed out and non-clickable with a tooltip 'The team member cannot be deleted because the team is synced with the Jira Cloud'
Plus icon is greyed out and non-clickable with a tooltip 'Any new team member cannot be added because the team is synchronized with the Jira Cloud group'

steps.action: Click on Plus button dropdown menu, select Create new Team based on Jira Group, pass the data and click Create
steps.data:
jiraGroup: TC-3261
teamName: TC-3261-Test
teamCode: 3261Test
startDate: today
steps.result:
Error appeared with the following message:

"Failed to create a team

The "TC-3261" group is already used as a source for another team"

rag.text:
Test: TC-3261 — Box Module - Teams - Creating new team based on Jira Group 
Priority: Medium | Status: In Review | Type: Manual
Folder: /BP/TS-112 Box Module - Teams
Labels: be-enterprise

Description:
BPE must be installed

Steps:
1. Navigate to Teams module of a boxName
   Data: boxName: TC-3261 Box Module - Teams - Creating new team based on Jira Group
   Expected: Teams module is displayed

Wizard menu appeared with 3 tiles:

* Create new team (dropdown)
* Assign existing 
* Duplicate & edit existing
2. Select Create new team dropdown menu
   Expected: Three options appear on the list:

* regular
* based on Jira Group
* based on Jira Team
3. Select ‘based on Jira Group’ option
   Expected: ‘Create new team based on Jira group’ modal window is displayed with the following fields to create a team:

* Jira Cloud group
* Team code
* Color picker
* Board dropdown with "Select board" placeholder 
* Start date of Team memberships with today's date placeholder
* Create button
* Cancel button
4. Select jiraGroup from dropdown menu, select startDate of Team memberships
   Data: jiraGroup: TC-3261
teamCode: TC3261
startDate: 01/Jun/22
   Expected: Jira Group TC-3261 is selected

Team name is set automatically to TC-3261

Team code is TC3261

Start date of Team memberships is 01/Jun/22  with a "i" icon next to the name and tooltip 'Start date must be specified - this allows the app to include members in team planning and calculations'

Cancel button and Create button are displayed
5. Click Create button
   Expected: Team TC-3261 based on Jira Group is created and it's visible on the list
6. Click on teamName and select the Details tab.
   Data: teamName: TC-3261
   Expected: Sidebar is expanded and displayed. Team name and code is displayed at the top of the sidebar. Violet lozenge JIRA CLOUD GROUP is displayed with a tooltip 'TC-3261 is based on and synchronized with Jira Cloud group'

Details tab is displayed.

Following fields are displayed: 

* Based on Jira Cloud group (red asterisk) with a placeholder TC-3261
* Name (red asterisk): TC-3261 
* Code and color: TC3261 and violet color
* Jira Board with "Select board" placeholder and information below: "Use the Board link to specify which Jira Scrum Boards are used by your Teams. This way, each time you add a new synchronized Box, the App can automatically create sprints on that Board."
7. Click on Members tab
   Expected: Members tab is loaded and displayed. The following users are displayed on the list:

* TC-3261-01
* TC-3261-02
* TC-3261-03
* TC-3261-04

Their active membership starts from 01/Jun/22, availability is 100% and skills are empty

User selector is greyed out and non-clickable
8. Hover over Remove button (trash icon) in teamMember row
   Data: teamMember: TC-3261-01
   Expected: Remove button is greyed out and non-clickable with a tooltip 'The team member cannot be deleted because the team is synced with the Jira Cloud'
9. Hover over Plus icon
   Expected: Plus icon is greyed out and non-clickable with a tooltip 'Any new team member cannot be added because the team is synchronized with the Jira Cloud group'
10. Click on Plus button dropdown menu, select Create new Team based on Jira Group, pass the data and click Create
   Data: jiraGroup: TC-3261
teamName: TC-3261-Test
teamCode: 3261Test
startDate: today
   Expected: Error appeared with the following message:

"Failed to create a team

The "TC-3261" group is already used as a source for another team"
